verdict.rationale: The repo ships a dedicated skill-creator SKILL.md whose stated purpose is 'creating new skills and iteratively improving them,' including benchmarking skill performance and optimizing descriptions for triggering accuracy, plus a template SKILL.md and packaging guidance (frontmatter, bundled files, plugin manifests) for distribution. Runtime probe confirms it installs cleanly as a real skill via third-party tooling. missing for 10: independent hands-on account of actually using skill-creator to author a new skill end-to-end, and clearer coverage of the 'packaging for distribution via marketplace' step being driven by the meta-skill itself rather than separate plugin docs.
